Q: What is the actual difference in using composition versus inheritance? A:

yes, perhaps I was too brief in explaining what inheritance is (although I never said it's just syntactic sugar), I've made a small modification to improve it (it wasn't and isn't my intention to go into depth), thanks for the “slap on the wrist” :)

Q: Only one usage of each socket address (protocol/network address/port) is normally permitted. (management.azure.com:443) A:

I think I found the answer to this question by some more troubleshooting in a related problem described here.

In short, the software Palo Alto Networks Terminal Server Agent was influencing available ports for user sessions. Using another server where this agent was not present, solved the problem.

Q: Error #110 with graph api : Requires pages_manage_ads or leads_retrieval permission to manage the object A:

You can enable this permission in your App Dashboard.

Go to Use Cases → Customize, and there you will see a list of available permissions for your app. From that section, you need to activate the permissions required for Lead Ads, specifically the leads_retrieval permission.

The error you are receiving:

(#100) Requires pages_manage_ads or leads_retrieval permission to manage the object

means that your current access token does not include the leads_retrieval permission, which is required to retrieve leads from Lead Ads.

Q: undefined function maps:to_json/1 A:

It looks like json was added to the standard library in 2024.

Erlang/OTP 27 [erts-15.1.1] [source] [64-bit] [smp:12:12] [ds:12:12:10] [async-threads:1] [jit]
Eshell V15.1.1 (press Ctrl+G to abort, type help(). for help)

1> Dic = #{b => 1, a => 2}.
#{b => 1,a => 2}

2> json:encode(Dic).
["{",
 [[34,<<"b">>,34],58|<<"1">>],
 [[44,[34,<<"a">>,34],58|<<"2">>]],
 "}"]

More information is at EEP 68: JSON library.
